description: Track tender submission deadlines with days-left countdown, red/orange urgency color coding (overdue / ≤3d critical / ≤7d soon), EMD & tender-fee notes, and a per-tender document checklist with completion %.
name: Tender Deadline Tracker

description: Compare tender criteria (minimum turnover, experience, past contracts, EMD capacity, category, registration) against your company profile → eligible / marginal / no-go verdict with a per-criterion gap list.
name: Tender Eligibility Checker

description: Bid cost buildup: direct cost heads + indirect % + contingency % + margin % → bid price, with tender fee and EMD tracked as separate upfront cash (EMD refundable, not part of bid price).
name: Tender Cost Estimator

description: Given estimated cost and win-probability at low/high bid prices (linearly interpolated), scans the band and recommends the bid price maximizing expected value = (price − cost) × P(win).
name: Bid Price Optimizer

description: Retention % per contract, release due dates (completion + defect liability period), released vs locked amounts, and total locked working capital across up to 25 contracts.
name: Retention Money Calculator

description: Budgeted vs actual per cost head with % complete → variance %, CPI, and projected final cost (EAC = BAC/CPI), flagged on-track / watch / overrun with portfolio roll-up.
name: Project Cost Overrun Detector

description: Contract milestones with due dates, % complete, weightage and linked payments; automatic delayed/due-soon flags, weighted overall progress %, and released/pending/delayed payment summary.
name: Contract Milestone Tracker

description: Liquidated damages calculator: LD % per week of delay on contract value (part-week counts as full), capped at max % — defaults to the typical 0.5%/week, 10%-cap GeM norm with grace-day exclusion.
name: Project Delay Penalty Tool (LD Calculator)

description: Two-bid system (technical + financial) document checklist with per-section and overall completion %, ready-to-submit flag, pending-documents list, and addable NIT-specific custom documents.
name: Tender Submission Checklist

description: RA (running account) bill register: certified vs paid per bill, holdback %, unpaid aging buckets (0–30 / 31–60 / 61–90 / 90+ days), collection summary and recovery %.
name: Contractor Payment Manager
